ai_summary: Ceinsys Tech Limited has filed a document confirming the non-applicability of SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. This is due to the company having 100% of its shares in dematerialized form and receiving no dematerialization or rematerialization requests during the period. This indicates a fully digitized shareholding structure and good operational compliance, with no material impacts or red flags identified.
